text:
amal: Quick thread Private deploy GA connectivity + roadmap asks. Need one opinionated default, clear upgrade paths, and policy for migrations + billing. Thoughts?

frank: +1 to relay-as-default for GA. Low lift for customers. But two new items to add: 1) map connectivity mode to pricing tier (relay=standard, egres­s-pool=premium, peering=enterprise) so sales and billing are consistent; 2) automated compliance checklist for customers that need IP ownership proof (SOC2 / PCI).

rhea: Relay default is fine. For the customer-egress path we should require a signed token verification + an optional reverse-proxy cert verification for higher assurance customers. Add a step to revoke egress IPs if we detect tunneling/abuse.

netops-tess: Ops constraints: regional relay pools, hard IP quotas per-region, and simulated exhaustion tests in staging. Also: introduce staged rollback phases instead of a single-hit revert. Proposed phases: 
- Phase 1: soft-fallback (route 10% traffic back to relay)
- Phase 2: hard-fallback (route 100% and mark degraded)
This reduces blast radius.

cs-kim: Field asks: customers want predictable cutover SLAs and proration for egress fees. If they move from relay -> premium egress mid-billing-cycle, finance wants proration and a clear invoice line. Also CS needs a one-click "schedule migration" UI with templates and consent language.

amal: Good calls. I'm proposing the following decision for roadmap: default=relay (GA), customer-egress=self-serve opt-in (validated token + optional cert), peering=sales-gated Dedicated only. Migration semantics: declarative migration object + staged rollback phases + dry-run.

frank: Agree. Add an acceptance item: the Console must show estimated monthly delta for egress cost per tenant before applying the migration. Also require a risk score (low/med/high) computed from latency baseline + probe success rate.

rhea: API sketch for migration object (declarative):
```
POST /v1/tenants/:tid/migrations
{
  "target_mode":"egress",
  "egress_ips":["203.0.113.9"],
  "start_iso":"2026-02-12T02:00:00-08:00",
  "plan":{
    "steps":[{"type":"validate"},{"type":"canary","pct":10,"duration_s":300},{"type":"cutover","drain_s":30,"warm_s":60}],
    "rollback":"staged"
  },
  "dry_run":true
}
```
Response returns risk_score + estimated_cost_delta + problems[].

netops-tess: Love the staged rollback. Implementation note: agent should expose `POST /agent/:id/drain?timeout=30s` and `POST /agent/:id/warm?secs=60` so platform orchestration can coordinate. Also need `GET /tenants/:tid/connectivity/status` with fields `mode, health, pool_region, last_probe, ip_quota` (display-only).

cs-kim: For compliance flow: when a customer opts into egress and marks "compliance=required", auto-create a checklist that includes: signed token proof, certificate match (if requested), legal egress registration form, and an audit entry. Include an exportable PDF for auditors.

amal: Billing note: Frank, can you work with Finance to model per-tenant cost estimates and proration logic? We need a small API that returns `estimated_monthly_delta` used in Console dry-run.

frank: On it. I'll prototype `GET /billing/estimate?tenant=:tid&mode=egress` -> {"delta_cents":12345, "notes":["relay baseline","egress egress-ip-fee"]}. Also will add a flag for cost-avoidance suggestions (e.g., canary_pct reduces cost by X).

rhea: IPv6 corner: support customers that only provide IPv6 egress by accepting IPv6 in the validation flow and documenting whether relay provides NAT64 or not. If relay lacks NAT64 in a region, block opt-in with a clear error.

netops-tess: Testing plan: create a resiliency pipeline that runs a "migration storm" across staging regions to validate drain/warm, staged fallback, and pool rotation. Also add a synthetic traffic generator to measure p99 delta during canaries.

amal: Acceptance criteria to gate GA on roadmap ticket: 
- Default relay path works with onboarding template and regional relay pools documented
- Customer-egress self-serve flow with signed-token validation + optional cert proof + dry-run estimate
- Declarative migration API with canary and staged rollback phases implemented and smoke-tested
- Console shows per-tenant mode, last_probe, risk_score, and estimated_cost_delta; one-click schedule + cancel for CS
- Billing: proration + estimated_monthly_delta endpoint implemented for sales/CS
- Peering documented and gated to Dedicated with manual ops sign-off checklist
- IPv6: validation/guardrails in place or blocking behavior documented
- Staging resiliency tests including IP exhaustion simulation and migration storm runbook

cs-kim: Action items: I'll draft the CS template + legal consent text and the exportable auditor PDF flow.

netops-tess: I'll draft staged rollback implementation details, agent drain/warm endpoints, and the staging test harness.

frank: I'll ship the billing estimate API prototype and cost model by EOW.

rhea: I'll implement the validation flow + token mechanism and IPv6 checks.

amal: I'll update the roadmap ticket with these acceptance criteria and schedule a short review next Tue. If we agree I'll mark GA scope accordingly. :thumbsup:

pm-bot: pm-bot: Created doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/private-deploy-connectivity-roadmap-v2 (comments enabled) :robot_face:

(ended)
